from: Simon's bot-team spec, 2026-11-01, §4 (RULES.md, the team law). Each law names the check that enforces it: code in this repo that exists now, a later build step's check (re-checked when that step is measured), or no code, with the plain reason.

laws.law: One role per bot. Work passes between bots through the feed.

checks.how: a handoff line is refused unless it names the next persona
each persona's allowed tools and owned outputs (the roster)

laws.law: Seal what 'done' means first, before the work.

checks.how: the auditor fails a build whose receipt does not name a seal committed before its code

laws.law: Every claim links a receipt anyone can re-run.

checks.how: a done with no link is flagged no-receipt by the writer
the auditor re-hashes the receipt and re-runs its tests

laws.law: Using a tool that is not on your list is a FLAG.

checks.how: the auditor compares the tools a bot used with its allow-list

laws.law: The auditor checks every build, listing, post draft and deliverable.

checks.how: every NEEDS SIMON item shows the auditor's verdict, or 'not yet audited'

laws.law: NEEDS SIMON, never automatic: publishing, posting, client sends, prices, payments, terms, releases to main, money, legal, personal data.

checks.how: post and listing lines always need the owner, whatever the bot sent
only Simon's signed decisions count as his answer
an outward step goes only when its exact text is approved and nothing is paused
a job that leaves or commits the company, or that cannot be read, goes to Simon (fails closed)
the auditor's plain-language check (jargon list, then the local model's read)

laws.law: No earnings claims, no crypto wording, no partner names without their consent.

checks.how: the auditor's overclaim, crypto-wording and consent checks

laws.law: Follow every platform's rules. A blocked login or a CAPTCHA goes to Simon; it is never worked around.

checks.none: No code in this repo operates a platform: the bots that do (on Grok Bot's computer) carry this law in their persona cards. What code can do, it does: a blocker line that needs the owner reaches the top of the rollup.

checks.how: a write that removes or changes an earlier feed line is refused
the company journal is a hash chain: a changed entry breaks it
